assertions.text: Table has at least one column name ending with '?' (e.g. 'Discount?' or 'Expected?')
Table has exactly 3 data rows (GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE)
assertions.evidence:
Gold customer   | GOLD          | 20
    Silver customer | SILVER        | 10
    Bronze customer | BRONZE        | 0

assertions.text: Test method body contains only one assertEquals (or equivalent assertion) — not three
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Method body contains only assertEquals call with no conditional logic

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column

Test method has either a @DisplayName annotation or a method name that reads as a clear, descriptive title when converted from camelCase/snake_case (e.g. 'discountByCustomerTier' → 'Discount By Customer Tier'). Not a generic name like 'test1' or 'testMethod'.
assertions.evidence: void calculatesDiscountByTier(...) - converts to 'Calculates Discount By Tier'

assertions.text: If @Description is present, it provides context beyond what the table rows already express — such as fixed values shared by all rows, where/when the rule applies, or open questions. Does NOT merely restate the column names or summarise what the rows show. It is acceptable to omit @Description if the table already conveys all relevant context (e.g. fixed values are included as a column rather than hardcoded in the method body).
assertions.evidence: @Description("Order value is 100 for all scenarios.") - provides context about the fixed order value parameter not shown in table columns

assertions.text: Annotations appear in order: @DisplayName (if present), @Description (if present), @TableTest — not any other order.
If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description("Order value is 100 for all scenarios.") - text is short enough for single line, textblock not required
